relations.evidence: ADR 0024 note (2026-10-07): "Owning the agent loop is no longer deferred. The engine builds its own runtime in stages behind this seam ... see ADR 0045. Items 1 (the seam), 2, 3 and 5 stand; item 4 holds while ADK is a runtime."
relations.note: In part: supersedes the deferral of owning the agent loop and ADK as the lasting runtime; the seam, turn-wide controls, boundary suite and A2A stance stand.

relations.evidence: ADR 0046 Consequences: "The GPT, Grok and Kimi adapters carry their reasoning state through the same field under their own provider ids (openai, xai, moonshot)."
ADR 0046 Decision, Storage: "trimEventForStorage and the session services keep the field whole; the transcript projection drops it with the rest of a past turn."
ADR 0047 maps reasoning: none on Ollama to reasoning_effort "none", the one value ADR 0027 found Ollama's /v1 endpoint honours; the model zoo's qwen_local relies on it.
ADR 0047: "high stops at 16,384 because the Claude adapter raises max_tokens to at least the budget plus 2,048", keeping a non-streaming request under the Anthropic SDK ceiling.

ADR 0050 Decision: reasoning ids "send store: false and include: ['reasoning.encrypted_content']"; each run of reasoning items rides verbatim on the part after it and is replayed before that part within the turn's tool loop.
ADR 0050 Decision, Which ids: "xAI's grok-4.5 and grok-4.7, through the adapter hook replaysReasoning()". Other grok ids send nothing new.
ADR 0050 Decision, Replay: "currentTurnStart in lib/models/providerState.ts holds that rule for every adapter."

/operations/parity-harness.md: "`npm run parity` (`scripts/parity_check.ts`) answers one question per provider: does the engine's core work end to end on it? ... A runtime gate is a run of this script, not a manual check."
